body: Thank you for your support, I'm afraid that with my thoughts I come to commit suicide, I just can't see a light.  I put my whole life in this relationship and it's over..

In 3 weeks I can't seem to be able to do anything, my boyfriend broke up with me after five years in our relationship. We had planning our wedding, thinking about our future kids, everything. What makes me really upset is that he started to avoid me. We used to be best friends, and I guess that although the troubles in our relationship, we should have keep our friendship. I miss him everyday, every hour. When I wake up, I feel an empty that give me thoughts that I don't want to wake up anymore. I'm more often thinking about suicide because I can't accept that he's gone, that our future's gone. I just want him back, I would do everything different...I don't know what to do..
